subject: Marketplace reseller addendum — clause alignment, evidence & ops handoff
messages:
From: sales@cloudbazaar.com
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Cc: alex.kline@retailtech.io
Date: Fri, 11 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Draft reseller addendum + onboarding checklist

Hi Karthik,

Thanks for the call this morning. Per our discussion we've attached a draft reseller addendum that maps marketplace listing fees, commission waterfall, and audit/evidence obligations back to the seller (PartnerCo) with a pass-through clause for certain tax and marketplace fees.

Key asks from CloudBazaar:
- Standard marketplace fee pass-through language so CloudBazaar does not have to absorb third-party marketplace listing taxes.
- Audit window limited to 12 months with notice and a narrow evidence list (billing + invoice trail).
- Ops handoff: an onboarding checklist for reseller billing and metering (we included a sample spreadsheet).

Can Redwood review the attached and confirm whether the pass-through language and the audit scope are acceptable or whether you need a carve-out for our data residency requirements? We have a RetailTech pilot (Alex) that wants to go live by mid-July.

Attachments: CloudBazaar_Reseller_Addendum_v1.docx, evidence_inventory_CloudBazaar.xlsx

Thanks,
Priya Sharma
Head of Marketplace Partnerships
CloudBazaar
priya.sharma@cloudbazaar.com
From: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com
Cc: sales@cloudbazaar.com
Date: Fri, 11 Jun 2027 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Draft reseller addendum + onboarding checklist

Marissa, Vivek — forwarding CloudBazaar's draft. High level notes from my side before we loop legal:

1) Pass-through: their template shifts listing/marketplace taxes to us unless we accept explicit language that they will invoice Redwood. We should keep pass-through but require an invoice trail and monthly reconciliations.

2) Audit scope: 12 months with "billing + invoice trail" is too broad. We need the right to request system logs for reconciliation (metering UUIDs, usage snapshots). If we limit to billing records only, we lose a solid audit path.

3) Data residency: CloudBazaar wants to limit obligations on their side for data copies outside of EU. RetailTech pilot is US-only, but we should include a clause that CloudBazaar must confirm where evidence will be stored and for how long.

4) Ops: their onboarding spreadsheet looks fine. Need an ops SLA for evidence delivery (10 business days) and a contact matrix.

I've done a first-pass redline (attached: karthik_redlines_20270610.docx). Can you review and flag any commercial asks you want to push (credits, invoice holdback, escrow)? Vivek, please review from a sales-ops / deal cadence perspective — will these asks push the go-live date? Alex (RetailTech) is cc'd for visibility.

— Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Head of Partnerships (Marketplace)
Redwood Inference
From: marissa_cole@redwood.com
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com
Cc: sales@cloudbazaar.com
Date: Fri, 11 Jun 2027 12:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Draft reseller addendum + onboarding checklist

Karthik — quick legal perspective (high level, not final):

- Pass-through: ok in principle but we need explicit invoicing and indemnity for any third-party taxes tied to their platform. Suggest addition: CloudBazaar to provide monthly invoice bundles with matching metering IDs.

- Audit rights: propose we accept 12-month lookback but narrow permitted evidence to: invoices, payment receipts, and exported meter logs corresponding to the invoiced periods. Any request for system access or PII must be redacted and handled via a SOC2 / legal evidence request.

- Data residency: require a representation that evidence will not be transferred outside the agreed regions without prior notice. For EU customers we need an explicit statement re: storage location.

- Remedies: if CloudBazaar cannot produce evidence within 10 business days, we keep the right to withhold disputed payouts until resolution (subject to cap of 90 days).

I attached inline comments in your redline and a short template for the evidence matrix. Also flagged the indemnity sentence — we should avoid language that makes Redwood the primary payer for marketplace taxes.

Marissa Cole
Sr. Counsel, Commercial Contracts
Redwood Inference
From: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com, sales@cloudbazaar.com
Date: Fri, 11 Jun 2027 16:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Draft reseller addendum + onboarding checklist

Thanks all — quick operational check and next steps from me:

- Timeline: retail pilot (RetailTech) is optimistic for mid-July. If we add invoice holdback or extended evidence windows, ops needs to know now. We can hit mid-July if CloudBazaar accepts the 10-business-day evidence SLA and automatic monthly reconciliations. Anything beyond that pushes integration into late July.

- Technical: engineering will need the metering export schema by June 18 to validate mapping. I'll open an ENG ticket and share the field list (see Atlassian link above).

- Commercial: I'm ok with the proposed withholding for undisputed shortfalls, but we should cap potential holds to one invoice cycle or $50k whichever is lower for this pilot.

Next steps: Marissa to send final redline back to CloudBazaar with two variant options (pilot-friendly commercial cap + full commercial terms post-pilot). Karthik to confirm evidence contact + final onboarding dates with Priya.

— Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
Director, Partner Ops
Redwood Inference
